task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OBS-03 at src/design/obs-03-audit-log.md. Define the audit persistence architecture for all successful state-changing API requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), ensuring writes are atomic with business state changes in the same transaction. Specify exact audit record contract: audit_id UUID, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp, before_state, after_state, with immutable-record guarantees. Define actor extraction and action naming conventions across routes, transaction integration points, failure behavior when audit table is unavailable (entire mutation fails), and explicit exclusion of GET/read-only requests. Design GET /audit retrieval contract with filter semantics (actor_id, resource_type, resource_id, from, to), pagination alignment with API-06, ordering guarantees, and index/query strategy. Include edge-case handling for canceled token requests that already took action and for null before/after snapshots. Provide a requirement-to-design traceability matrix mapping every OBS-03 acceptance criterion and edge case to concrete modules/functions and test obligations. Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All OBS-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases map to explicit design elements
Atomic same-transaction audit-write behavior is fully specified with failure semantics
Audit schema, immutability constraints, actor/action conventions, and snapshot semantics are concrete and testable
GET /audit filtering, pagination, and ordering behavior are fully specified
Traceability matrix identifies module boundaries and verification hooks for implementation/testing

result.summary: Design artefact for OBS-03 audit logging completed at src/design/obs-03-audit-log.md, including atomic transaction behavior, immutable audit contract, action/actor conventions, GET /audit retrieval semantics, and full acceptance-criteria traceability.
